answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms. Each agent enters through one narrow inlet, posts a 40-unit bond, and must trade with 12 unrelated peers to reach the mesa: no shared sponsor or funding source. Proven diversity earns a marble seal, carved once and hard to copy. A closed loop of fakes trading only with itself never earns one. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 units, while an honest agent pays 40 once and keeps rewards undiluted.
